problem: Fire-closure listing now dated 6 October 2026 and trail conditions 29 October 2026; Graybeal and Whatcom camps still closed, Brush Creek open to hikers, Bear Creek Camp still closed. FR 32 bypass sentence could not be verified.
corrected: Brush Creek Trail (the final approach corridor toward Whatcom Pass/Indian Mountain) reopened Sept. 2025 after a 3-year closure from the 2022 Brush Creek Fire; Graybeal, Graybeal Stock, and Whatcom Camps remain closed until further notice, with no end date given, as listed in the park's fire-closure listing updated October 6, 2026, and the trail is not fully stock-accessible. The Chilliwack River Trail has been cleared of down trees as far as Bear Creek Camp, as listed on the park's trail report of September 3, 2026, but is still brushy north of the Copper Ridge junction. Bear Creek Camp is closed from 2021 fire damage, as still listed in the park's trail conditions on October 29, 2026. A bypass has been built around a prior washout at the end of FR 32 to keep the Hannegan Trailhead reachable — check Mt. Baker Ranger District alerts before driving.

problem: Closure is real but the note omits the order's end date (31 December 2027); the fire closure on Chiwawa and Phelps Creek roads is still listed in October 2026.
corrected: Decent gravel for roughly the first 11 miles from WA-207, then narrow, rough, and high-clearance-recommended for the final ~12 miles to Trinity Trailhead; sections beyond Goose Creek have been closed in some years by flood damage and wildfire activity. Storm damage has closed the road to vehicles beyond the Atkinson Flat Campground junction, with no reopening estimate (Forest Service order in effect 20 May 2026 to 31 December 2027), cutting off the Trinity and Phelps Creek trailheads. A wildfire closure (Little Giant Fire) also covers the Chiwawa River Road and Phelps Creek Road as of October 2026. Check with the Wenatchee River Ranger District, (509) 548-2550, before you go.
